title: Cross-Desk Note with the Finance Desk on What the Customer Has Put Into a Commission
content:
# Cross-Desk Note with the Finance Desk on What the Customer Has Put Into a Commission

What the customer has put into a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is read either from the promotional financing plan that finances the till transaction the commission was written on, or from the deposits and staged payments booked to the commission itself. Which of the two, and how much of it, turns on whether such a plan finances that till transaction and on whether it still stands active.

## The three readings

| Where | What the customer has put into the commission is read as |
|---|---|
| A promotional financing plan held with the chain finances the till transaction the commission was written on and that plan still stands active | The payments settled on that plan together with the amount paid at the till when the sale was written |
| Such a plan finances that till transaction and no longer stands active | The financed amount on that plan together with the amount paid at the till |
| Otherwise | The deposits and staged payments booked to the commission |

## Where the records are

The till transaction the commission was opened on stands on the commission record. Whether a plan finances that same till transaction, the state that plan stands in, the financed amount at its opening, the amount the customer paid at the till on the day of sale, and the plan's own payment entries that finally settled are held under Belrose Promotional Financing Plans against that same till transaction. Payments settled on the plan are taken as a positive figure, as are the deposits and staged payments booked to the commission.

## Readings (hypothetical)

- A plan on the same till transaction standing active, payments settled on it coming to USD 4500.00 and USD 1000.00 paid at the till: what the customer has put in is USD 5500.00.
- The same plan standing paid off rather than active, its financed amount at opening USD 9000.00 and USD 1000.00 paid at the till: what the customer has put in is USD 10000.00.
- No plan on that till transaction, with USD 6000.00 of deposits and USD 3000.00 of staged payments booked to the commission: what the customer has put in is USD 9000.00.
